string_truncation_bug.bug_description: phase3b_mc.py line 70, phase3b3f_fullcab.py line 77, phase3b3f_val.py line 46 all use 'for hn, xn in zip(hl, str(nl).split())' instead of 'for hn, xn in zip(hl, nl)'. For jobs with node_count > numpy print threshold (1000), str(ndarray) abbreviates with '...', causing hostname-xname misalignment and dropped nodes.
